This '''brawl''' between [[Earsh]] and [[Khedryn Faal]], during a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], occurred in [[41 ABY]]. [[Jaden Korr]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], helped [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] escape from the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Fhost]].
